thread:
Tara (Sales Eng): Quick sync: Nimbus wants an RFP reply + capability matrix and a 12-day POC inside their US VPC. Baseline 4 GPUs, burst to 12, SOC2 evidence, KMIP HSM option, and sample SLOs. Need a non-binding quote + infra snippet by EOD.

Luis (AE): Noted. Ask: customer certs for mTLS? retention >90 days for audit logs?

Tara (Sales Eng): They said optional customer certs and configurable retention. Include default 30-day PII deletion and an option for longer retention at extra cost.

Yara (SRE): Private POC doable. Peering + initial nodes in ~48h. HSM/KMIP requires SOW and ~7 days. Minimal bootstrap for their infra:

# on Nimbus bastion
curl -fsSL https://peering.redwood.ai/agent/bootstrap -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" | sudo bash -s -- --env nimbus-poc --cidr 10.80.0.0/21

I'll need contact email + CIDR + burst windows.

Owen (Solutions): Uploaded nimbus_matrix_v1.xlsx and nimbus_rfi_answers_v1.pdf to the shared drive. Matrix maps features to their control IDs; RFI includes KMS/HSM notes and SOC2 redacted.

Luis (AE): Pricing suggestion: 50% off compute for first 12 days and waive onboarding. Yara, ballpark numbers so I can draft a non-binding quote?

Yara (SRE): Ballpark non-binding: 4xA100-eq reserved ~ $17k/mo; burst ~$15/GPU-hr; egress ~$0.09/GB. With 50% promo prorated for 12 days estimate ~$1.8k - $3.0k depending on burst. HSM integration extra.

doc-bot: SOC2 Type II (redacted) attached.

Tara (Sales Eng): Perfect. I'll assemble the RFP reply with Owen's attachments, Yara's snippet, and the non-binding quote. Luis, approve promo?

Luis (AE): Approved. Trial limits: 12 days, max burst 12 GPUs, trial support tier. Send when ready.
